{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rolo Room''' was located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. The room was reserved for interactive [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] adventures exclusively for the use of sub-adults. "Rolo" was a contraction for "Real Time Holo."
